name: owNet
purpose: The net built from scratch in Unit 4: it reads a short expression such as (a⨁b)⨂c, token by token, and writes the distributed form in prefix order (⨁ ⨂ a c ⨂ b c).
structure: Target (10 tokens); embedding 32; Input (10 tokens); embedding 32; encoder 2 × (4 heads, FF 128 ReLU); decoder 2 × (4 heads, FF 128 ReLU); softmax per token over 10 (Probabilities)
